# The UVM helpers (`uses: [uvm.yaml]`)

The built-in helper file `uvm.yaml` holds the vocabulary of svcheck's UVM
pack. A rule file names it with `uses: [uvm.yaml]` (a bare name with no
such file beside the rule file is the built-in one), and every rule of the
file can then call these helpers as functions. Use them rather than
writing your own: `is_component(cls(node))`, `config_db(node)`,
`factory_create(node)`. A comment line (`# ----`) starts a group.
`uses:` also brings the file's content classifiers (`unit` axis: `agent`,
`env`, `test`, `tb-top`, `seq-lib`, `regmodel`, `base-lib`) into a run of
the file's rules, for `applies_to: { unit: agent }`.

- `is(c, base)`: c is the UVM class `base` or derives from it ("uvm_object", ...).
  ```
  derives_from(c, "uvm_pkg::" + base)
  ```
- `cls(n)`: The class, and the subroutine, a node is in (null outside one).
  ```
  enclosing(n, Class)
  ```
- `method(n)`
  ```
  enclosing(n, Subroutine)
  ```
- `helper_of(m, c, phase)`: Method m of class c is called from c's `phase` method (a helper of that phase), one level deep.
  ```
  m != null && c != null && descendants(c, Call).exists(k,
  k.subroutine == m && method(k) != null && method(k).name == phase)
  ```
- `registered(c)`: Class c registers itself with the factory: it declares its own `type_id`, as the utils macros do. An inherited one creates the base.
  ```
  c.members.exists(m, m.name == "type_id")
  ```
- `based(c)`: Another package derives from class c: c is a base class of a library (lowRISC's dv_base_*), not a unit.
  ```
  subclasses(c).exists(s, s.carrier != c.carrier)
  ```
- `is_this(e)`: Expression e is `this` (as an argument, through a conversion to the formal's type).
  ```
  (e.isa(NamedValue) && e.name == "this") ||
  (e.isa(Conversion) && e.operand.isa(NamedValue) && e.operand.name == "this")
  ```

## Roles

- `is_component(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_component")
  ```
- `is_object(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_object") && !is(c, "uvm_component")
  ```
- `is_sequence(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_sequence_base")
  ```
- `is_item(c)`: A sequence item: not a sequence, which is also a uvm_sequence_item.
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_sequence_item") && !is(c, "uvm_sequence_base")
  ```
- `is_driver(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_driver")
  ```
- `is_monitor(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_monitor")
  ```
- `is_env(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_env")
  ```
- `is_test(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_test")
  ```
- `is_scoreboard(c)`
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_scoreboard")
  ```
- `is_port(c)`: TLM ports, exports and imps: built with new() by convention.
  ```
  is(c, "uvm_port_base")
  ```

## Phases: the common phases, as methods of uvm_component

- `PHASES`
  ```
  ["build_phase", "connect_phase", "end_of_elaboration_phase",
  "start_of_simulation_phase", "run_phase", "extract_phase", "check_phase",
  "report_phase", "final_phase"]
  ```
- `RUN_PHASES`: The run-time phases, which run in parallel with run_phase.
  ```
  ["pre_reset_phase", "reset_phase", "post_reset_phase", "pre_configure_phase",
  "configure_phase", "post_configure_phase", "pre_main_phase", "main_phase",
  "post_main_phase", "pre_shutdown_phase", "shutdown_phase", "post_shutdown_phase"]
  ```

## Calls

- `discarded(c)`
  ```
  parent(c).isa(ExprStmt) || void_cast(parent(c))
  ```
- `void_cast(e)`
  ```
  e.isa(Conversion) && e.type.name == "void
  ```
- `config_db(k)`: Call k is a static method of uvm_config_db#(T): set, get, exists, wait_modified.
  ```
  k.classType != null && k.classType.classDecl != null &&
  k.classType.classDecl.qname == "uvm_pkg::uvm_config_db"
  ```
- `factory_create(k)`: Call k is `T::type_id::create(...)`, the factory's create of a registered class; k.type is T.
  ```
  k.isa(Call) && k.name == "create" && k.classType != null &&
  k.classType.classDecl != null &&
  k.classType.classDecl.qname in ["uvm_pkg::uvm_component_registry", "uvm_pkg::uvm_object_registry"]
  ```
- `unchecked(k)`: Call k's result is thrown away, written as a plain call statement (not `void'(...)`, which throws it away on purpose).
  ```
  parent(k).isa(ExprStmt) && !stmt_void(parent(k))
  ```
- `stmt_void(s)`
  ```
  s.isa(ExprStmt) && s.isVoidCast
  ```

## Contexts

- `is_config_db(t)`
  ```
  t != null && t.classDecl != null && t.classDecl.qname == "uvm_pkg::uvm_config_db"
  ```
- `holds(p, base)`
  ```
  classes(p).exists(c, !based(c) && is(c, base))
  ```
- `user(c)`
  ```
  !c.inLibrary && !based(c)
  ```
